name: Survival needs
summary: Hunger, thirst, temperature and sleep decay over time and are restored by eating, drinking, sleeping and items; HUD bars flash on warning, critical and restored, and saves keep the readings.

parameters.doc: Godot's UI flag: the bars show only when the world opts in

extensionPoints.signature: ItemDefinition.effects { hunger | thirst | temperature | sleep: number } -> consumeForNeeds
extensionPoints.doc: food, drink and remedies restore needs through their authored effects
eat, drink, sleep and any action a world adds
well fed, cold, sick: a multiplier on one need's decay
the host's clock calls advanceSurvival; the arithmetic is core's

assistant.summary: Needs are core's (src/survival/needs.ts): decay per whole tick, bands, deprivation damage, restores and the save block; the HUD bars are survivalHudView (src/survival/survival-hud.ts). Stamina is the stamina pack's meter, not a need.
notes: Pass the host's play clock to advanceSurvival; never decay per frame in engine code.
Hand advanceSurvival's hurt to hurtPlayer (the vitals pack), not to a health number of your own.
Decay rates, thresholds and presets are the world's (WorldIR.survival); the knobs here are parameters.
doNot: Treat stamina as a fifth need: StaminaPool owns it.
Pick bar colours in engine code: tone and flash come from the view.
